Lay On Hands.summary: Healing pool of 5 × Paladin level HP, refilled on a Long Rest; 5 points from it cure Poisoned instead of healing.

oath-of-glory.summary: A paladin sworn to heroic deeds who bolsters allies' vigor, speed and defense.

Inspiring Smite.summary: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend a Channel Divinity use to split 2d8 + Paladin level Temporary HP among any creatures within 30 ft, you included.

Oath of Glory Spells.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

Peerless Athlete.summary: Bonus Action, one Channel Divinity use: for 1 hour, Advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks and +10 ft on Long and High Jumps.

Aura of Alacrity.summary: +10 ft Speed. An ally who first enters your Aura of Protection on a turn, or starts its turn there, gets +10 ft Speed until its next turn ends.

Glorious Defense.summary: Reaction when you or a creature you see within 10 ft is hit: add your CHA mod (min +1) to its AC against that attack; on a miss, make one weapon attack at the attacker if it's in range. CHA mod uses per Long Rest.

Living Legend.summary: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Advantage on Charisma checks, a Reaction to reroll a failed save, and once per turn a missed weapon attack can hit instead. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot to use it again.

oath-of-the-ancients.summary: A paladin who defends life, light and the natural world with primal magic.

Nature's Wrath.summary: Magic action, one Channel Divinity use: chosen creatures within 15 ft make a STR save or are Restrained for 1 minute, saving again at the end of each of their turns.

Oath of the Ancients Spells.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

Aura of Warding.summary: You and allies inside your Aura of Protection resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

Undying Sentinel.summary: Once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP but not killed, stay at 1 HP and then heal 3 × Paladin level. You also stop aging and can't be aged by magic.

Elder Champion.summary: Bonus Action, 1 minute: foes in your aura have Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity, you regain 10 HP at each turn start, and 1-action spells can be cast as a Bonus Action. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

oath-of-vengeance.summary: A paladin sworn to hunt down and punish grievous evil at any cost.

Oath of Vengeance Spells.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

Vow of Enmity.summary: As part of the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity use to mark a creature within 30 ft: Advantage on attacks against it for 1 minute. If it drops to 0 HP, move the mark to another creature within 30 ft for free.

Relentless Avenger.summary: When your Opportunity Attack hits, the target's Speed becomes 0 for the turn, and that same Reaction lets you move half your Speed without provoking.

Soul of Vengeance.summary: Reaction right after your Vow of Enmity target makes an attack roll, hit or miss: make a melee attack against it if it's in range.

Avenging Angel.summary: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 ft with hover, and foes who start a turn in your aura make a WIS save or are Frightened for 1 minute (ends on damage), with attacks against them at Advantage. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.
